name: Translate
description: Translate image in X and Y
help:
# translate

Translate image in X and Y

## Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Range | Description |
|-----------|------|---------|-------|-------------|
| x | float | 0 | -1-1 | X |
| y | float | 0 | -1-1 | Y |
| wrap | int | repeat | mirror/repeat/clamp | Wrap |
